title: Punishing one to warn another
literal_meaning: Beat the daughter to teach the daughter-in-law.
explanation: One person is punished so that someone else takes the warning. The indirect target is the point of the saying.
meaning_odia: ଦଣ୍ଡ ଜଣଙ୍କୁ ଦିଆଯାଉଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଭୟ ଦେଖାଇବାର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଆଉ ଜଣେ। ଜଣକୁ ଉଦାହରଣ କରି ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଚୁପ୍ କରାଇବାର ପରୋକ୍ଷ ଚାପକୁ ଏହା ବୁଝାଏ। ଘରୋଇ ହିଂସାର ଚିତ୍ର ଥିଲେ ବି ଏହାକୁ ଶିଖାଇବାର ଉଚିତ ପଦ୍ଧତି ବୋଲି ନେବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A supervisor publicly rebukes one person while looking at another who made the same mistake. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The household image contains violence against women. Recording it does not endorse that violence or claim every family behaves this way.

witnesses.note: Exact item wording; explanation reads the explicit contrast between recipient and intended learner.

odia_summary: ଦଣ୍ଡ ଜଣଙ୍କୁ ଦିଆଯାଉଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଭୟ ଦେଖାଇବା ବା ସତର୍କ କରିବାର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଆଉ ଜଣେ।
english_summary: One person is punished to frighten or warn another; the saying describes this tactic rather than recommending it.
